title: Starting Amount of the Reference-Testing Cancellation Handling Fee
content:
The starting amount of the reference-testing cancellation handling fee on a Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Esoteric Reference Testing class depends on how the accession is billed. For an insurance-billed accession it also depends on the payer class of its coverage with Insurance Coverage & Claims.

**Clause.** When the accession is billed self-pay and carries a good faith estimate amount whose estimate date is within **90** calendar days before today, and on or after the date of the latest add-on line on the accession, the starting amount is **10 percent** of that estimate. When the accession is billed insurance and the payer class of its coverage prohibits patient billing beyond the copay, the starting amount is zero. Any other reference-testing accession starts from the class fee.

| Billing method | Estimate on the accession | Payer class of the coverage billed | Starting amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Self-pay | Dated within the last 90 calendar days, and on or after the latest add-on line (or no add-on on the accession) | — | 10 percent of the estimate |
| Self-pay | None, older than 90 days, or dated before the latest add-on line | — | the class fee |
| Insurance | — | Prohibits patient billing beyond the copay | zero |
| Insurance | — | Allows patient billing | the class fee |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical; today is 30 June).**

- An estimate of 300.00 dated 1 April (90 days before today), no add-on: 10 percent of 300.00, that is 30.00.
- The same estimate dated 31 March (91 days before today): the class fee.
- An estimate dated 10 June, with an add-on line dated 10 June: on or after the add-on, so 10 percent of the estimate.
- An estimate dated 10 June, with an add-on line dated 12 June: before the latest add-on, so the class fee.
